:::{#hero-heading}

Hello! My name is Lynndsay Terpsma and I am an undergraduate student at the University of British Columbia's Okanagan campus. My research interests are in behavioural ecology, particularly focusing in movement ecology using computational approaches. I also have interest in meta-analyses and statistical modelling in ecological systems.

## Experience

- Researcher, Univerisity
- Consultant, Company
- Intern, Institute

## Education

- Bachelor of Science, University of British Columbia Okanagan\n
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Honours Zoology [Expected: April 2027]\n
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Thesis Title: *A Computational Approach to Identifying Evolutionarily Stable Strategies in Mammalian Search Behaviour* \n
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Supervisor: Dr. Micheal Noonan, Quantitative Ecology Lab
